name: Sans Multiverse: Randomizer
desc:
{A game coded by Aloptomova and modelled by pinksheepyxu}

An obby game based on both Sans Multiverse and Sans Generator.
Obbies will be generated across a platform for you to complete.

Complete the obby to recieve Sans Tokens. (A use for those are coming soon.)
Difficulty will be decided randomly, aswell as the AU of the Sans.

There are secret combinations to Sanses that result in unique bosses.

|----------------------------------->

Private Server Features:

+Removed fee for forcing AUs and lowering counter
+-Only Server Owner can /Restart

-Cannot gain Sans Tokens, Wins (if boss is forced), or Deaths.
